about.title: About
about.lead: Data → agents → physical AI, documented in public. The résumé is a component, not the centre.
about.intro: Guillaume Verbiguié is building this Lab from Paris. Evidence below comes from public GitHub repositories. Nothing is invented: if it is not in a repo or on this page, it is not a claimed experience.
trajectory: 2021 — public data-engineering training projects (Spark/S3 data lake, Redshift warehouse).
2025 — on-chain analytics as a data terrain (CSV dashboard, anomaly detection + MLflow).
2026 — agentic copilots and grounded RAG (Decision Copilot, Knowledge Copilot, automation agent).
Now — this Lab: bilingual, measurable, Physical AI as a direction without pretending to be a robotics engineer.
about.now: A public system to observe, learn, experiment and measure intelligent systems. SignalLab and Ask My Lab come after a shareable V1.
about.notTitle: What this page does not claim
about.not: No robotics-engineer role, no invented agent clients, no skill bars. Private repos (e.g. PhotoMind) exist but are not public evidence until they are opened or described with the same rigor.
about.scopeBody: Does this help understand, build, evaluate or apply intelligent systems? If not, it stays out of the Lab.
